task.title: Browse and edit code
task.body:
Small edits to any file, and references to lines. See [[Experience#code]].

- [ ] File tree with a filter and recent files
- [ ] Viewer: highlighting, line numbers, find, wrap; Markdown preview; images
- [ ] Select lines → **Copy reference** (`[[path#L10-L20]]`); references open with their lines selected; pinned ones read-only at their revision
- [ ] Edit with undo, find and replace; new file, rename, delete
